summary: Agent details visibility is one persisted device-local preference for every agent. Narrow conversations auto-hide details instead of replacing their content.

schema.detail: Adds optional agent_details to the TUI-local prefs.json; absent defaults to visible. No shared schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Conversation Ctrl+D changes the preference for all agents. Narrow details-in-place is removed; conversations retain their 90-column side-by-side threshold.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No manual migration. The old per-agent visibility was in-memory only.

recovery.detail: Older clients ignore the additive local preference field.
